biggest_catch: Your friend has to make 10 separate debit purchases of at least $5 each within 60 days of opening the account, or you get nothing.
catches: The referred Friend must be a new WECU member (not a member in the last 12 months).
Friend must open a Spend Plus or Spend Free checking product and make 10 debit card purchases of at least $5 each from that account within the first 60 days of account opening.
Program cannot be combined with any other new member offers or promotions.

Referrer must be the Primary Account Holder (TRO) of at least one active deposit account and be in good standing to receive payment; employees of the company, its subsidiaries, affiliates or promotional agencies are ineligible.
Both Referrer and Friend must have an email on file with WECU.
Referrer can earn a maximum of 5 rewards per calendar year (maximum $500); rewards are scheduled to be paid on day 63, with possible delays.

steps: Visit the official WECU Refer A Friend checking site and follow the onscreen instructions to refer a friend.
Receive your unique personal referral link and provide it to a friend who is not a WECU member (and was not one in the last 12 months).
Your friend applies for and qualifies for WECU membership and opens a Spend Plus or Spend Free checking product.
Within the first 60 days of account opening, the friend makes 10 debit card purchases of at least $5 each from that checking account.
You receive $100 deposited into your longest active WECU checking (or savings) account after 60 days, scheduled for payment on day 63 - up to 5 rewards ($500) per calendar year.
timing: Referrer reward deposited into the referrer's longest active WECU checking account (or savings if no checking) after 60 days, provided qualifications are met; rewards scheduled to be paid on day 63.
